channel.title: OpenChemWorks — methods, application notes and insights
channel.description: Amino acid analysis: methods, application notes and insights from OpenChemWorks, Davis, California.

item.title: How AQC Derivatization Works
item.description: How AQC tags primary and secondary amino acids for HPLC-UV at 260 nm: the urea chemistry, by-products, borate pH, the heating step and practical limits.

item.title: Sample Preparation for Free Amino Acid Analysis
item.description: Why protein comes out before free amino acid analysis: ultrafiltration vs acid or solvent precipitation, dilution into range, and internal standards.

item.title: Free vs Total Amino Acids: Which One You Need
item.description: Free amino acids are unbound; total ones are measured after acid hydrolysis. What hydrolysis changes, and which your media, label or hydrolysate needs.

item.title: Reading an Amino Acid Profile: Units, Ratios and Flags
item.description: How to interpret amino acid analysis results: µM vs mg/L, mol% and ratios, below-LOQ flags, dilution correction, the chromatogram and time courses.

item.title: How We Control Quality in Amino Acid Analysis
item.description: The QC behind our amino acid results: internal standard, QC standard each run, detector checks, reagent blanks, spike recovery and below-LOQ flags.

item.title: Analyte Reference: The 19 Amino Acids, Ammonia and the Extended Panel
item.description: Glutamine stability in solution, asparagine deamidation, tryptophan and cysteine chemistry, ammonia sources and the extended panel, analyte by analyte.

item.title: Amino Acids in Serum-Free Media for Cultivated Meat: The Cost Drivers
item.description: What published techno-economic analyses say about media cost in cultivated meat, where amino acids fit, and how spent-media data support cheaper media.

item.title: Why the Free Fraction of a Hydrolysate Matters
item.description: What a free amino acid profile shows about protein hydrolysates, peptones and yeast extracts that total composition misses: a review of published data.

item.title: Glutamine, Glutamate and Ammonia Across a Fed-Batch Run
item.description: What published CHO studies show about glutamine uptake, glutamine breakdown and ammonia in fed-batch culture, and how to sample and read all three.

item.title: What Amino Acid Analysis Costs, and What You Should Get for the Price
item.description: What drives the price of amino acid analysis (hydrolysis, panel size, preparation, calibration, minimums), our posted prices, a worked estimate and a checklist for the report.

item.title: Choosing an Amino Acid Method: AQC, OPA/FMOC, Ion-Exchange or LC-MS
item.description: Ion-exchange/ninhydrin, AQC, OPA/FMOC, PITC and LC-MS/MS compared on proline coverage, derivative stability, sensitivity, run time and matrix tolerance.
